title: Ombudsman suspends 5 DPWH engineers over P188-M alleged ‘ghost’ Bulacan flood control projects
summary: The Office of the Ombudsman ordered the preventive suspension of five Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Bulacan 1st District engineers amid an ongoing probe into alleged anomalies…

blocks.text: The Office of the Ombudsman ordered the preventive suspension of five Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Bulacan 1st District engineers amid an ongoing probe into alleged anomalies involving three flood control projects worth P188.9 million in Baliuag, Bulacan.
